scope: Existing crypto-spot-kit research protocols, archived result date fields, full-run Freqtrade metadata, dashboard backtest date metadata, forward observer code/time keys/history indices. No claim of auditing external projects or every prior human observation.
method: Read existing outcome files to extract dates/counts only; did not calculate new returns/features or open post-audit future observations. Two new November history checks read index columns only. Existing known historical V2 report was read to audit permanent-pause interpretation.

findings.note: Multiple spot, pool, factor, leverage, risk-budget studies and dashboard runs used these dates; evaluation/later names do not restore independence. Not every coin/feature was used every day, but common market outcome exposure precludes asserting a pristine historical market holdout.
Current minute and pullback V2 development/comparison period; 481 full days; overlapping subset of broader exposure.
Earlier whole-pool and BTC/ETH studies computed outcomes here. The minute cutoff was inherited from data-completeness issues, not an unused-market boundary.

BTC/ETH hourly histories enter four ongoing signal calculations; forward simulation started 2026-11-12T18:53:01Z. Does not claim historical P&L was tested from November 1; does prevent asserting no information contact.
Observed as BTC/ETH prehistory; this audit did not find a verified untouched earlier validation pool. Data being older is not proof of independence.

conditional_forward_plan.activation_rule: T0 = next complete UTC midnight strictly after freeze of feature definitions, availability/causality rules, candidate decision policy, all executable code, data-pool rules, cost assumptions and evaluator/hash manifest. If not fully frozen before 2026-11-14T00:00Z, mechanically shift T0 to next complete UTC day after actual full freeze; never choose from returns.
conditional_forward_plan.boundaries: Validation [T0,T0+90d), final holdout [T0+90d,T0+180d). No random split. This audit neither starts data capture nor claims future data exists.
conditional_forward_plan.final_holdout_rules: Unseal only once at its end after predeclared selection from validation. All model versions and allowed validation selection must be frozen before validation. Changing feature/strategy rules after seeing validation starts a new research version with fresh future validation; no replacement winner chosen using holdout.
conditional_forward_plan.monitoring: Separate safe health/data-latency monitoring from candidate performance inspection. If realized outcomes leak into development, record exposure and withdraw untouched label for that interval; do not silently rename it clean.

boundary_purge.exact_rule: Every label/markout/exit used for a preceding split must end strictly before boundary B; discard any event whose realized label ends at/after B. In addition drop prior-split signals during [B-65min,B). For the new split require signal availability >= B. No boundary-crossing pending setup/position is relabelled a fresh independent trade; clear setup/position state for standalone split account; retain a separately labelled continuous account path if specified.
boundary_purge.warmup: Past-only historical lookbacks may warm up new-period features and fixed rolling beta; no future labels/normalization fitted on both sides. Do not purge 720 hours simply because beta uses 720 known hours.

statistical_plan_recommendations.family: Freeze at most six feature groups, one or two variables each; primary 30min horizon only; list each long/short/interaction comparison that can drive selection in one complete primary family. Auxiliary 15/60min and neighborhood runs are diagnostic only; never substitute their best result.
statistical_plan_recommendations.multiplicity: Use one prespecified family-level correction, preferably Holm FWER 0.05 for a modest family with arbitrary dependence; if a joint block max-stat method is used it must be frozen before outcomes. Retain all attempts, missing-feature attempts and failed screens. Old development p values remain exploratory.
statistical_plan_recommendations.dependence: Assign event IDs; same-symbol overlapping event/label windows deduplicated before counting. Resample paired contiguous UTC time blocks jointly across symbols and long/short sides so market-wide co-movement is preserved. Report number of UTC days/weeks, distinct symbols and event clusters; these are not assumed independent trade counts.

minimum_evidence_not_power_guarantee.interpretation: Recommended administrative lower bounds, not a power proof or guarantee. Sparse comparisons remain unverified; do not extend until significant or lower limits after viewing returns. Full predeclared 90-day interval retained, CI width and tails decide uncertainty.

statistical_plan_recommendations.no_automatic_promotion: Positive cost-adjusted incremental effect, reproducible causal availability, coverage and uncertainty all required. Less loss than baseline is not profitability. At most three downstream branches, 1x initial gross cap; drawdown >15% fails screen and <=15% does not certify future risk. Dynamic leverage is separate later research.

censoring_and_annualization.existing_control: Keep original peak drawdown 8% permanent study pause, 5% new-risk reduction, daily 1.5% pause. Retain calendar equity after pause as cash; do not reopen to improve performance.
censoring_and_annualization.audit_finding: engine.py sets permanent_pause when prior known drawdown >=0.08, exits next open; subsequent signals rejected while equity path continues. Existing ~8% MDD is affected by stopping, not proof of sustained low-risk trading.
censoring_and_annualization.annualization: Current engine only reports CAGR when elapsed days >=365. Retain this rule: each 90-day validation/holdout reports realized total return, daily statistics and interval uncertainty; do not market a 90-day extrapolation as verified annual return. Historical 481-day CAGR is development evidence and includes cash pause time.

limitations: No access log proves all human/model information exposure; a failed search for prior use is not proof of untouched history.
CSV/JSON tables contain duplicated comparisons and carried-forward rows; row counts are not summed as independent experiments.
Active observer state changes continuously; recorded timestamps are a snapshot, not an immutable full-file hash.
This is an audit and registration recommendation; no fresh factor calculations/backtests, recorder start, account connection or simulator mutation occurred.

primary_method_source.claim: Sullivan, Timmermann and White (1999) evaluate technical rules accounting for the full universe of tried rules and data-snooping. The concrete dates, sample-count gates and purge length here are project design choices, not claimed as paper prescriptions.
